fingerprint_source: VB-000 disposable diagnostics and installed package query

versioning.structural.reason: Structural capture is implemented in source but remains unqualified pending the final acceptance campaign.

versioning.live_retention.reason: Same-profile retained view survived source host close and resumed on Wayland; production loss handling remains unqualified.

versioning.archive_capture.reason: MHTML save exposed a per-view exact-path request and completed on Wayland; production permits, deadlines and publication remain unqualified.

versioning.archive_offline.reason: Separate guarded profile blocked observed traffic, but form activation and production archive-surface isolation remain unqualified.

versioning.semantic_restore.reason: Conservative geometry, editable-draft, and paused-media reconstruction paths are implemented but lack final native qualification.

versioning.clean_branch.reason: Independent child profile and window ownership need native qualification.

versioning.cookie_identity.reason: Public QNetworkCookie lacks general Chromium partition identity.

versioning.cookie_snapshot.reason: The public cookie API has no complete consistent enumeration boundary; a persisted fixture cookie was present in browser request truth without an initial callback in the observed window.

versioning.cookie_seed_verify.reason: Synthetic SameSite Strict input returned as Default through the public native cookie-added callback; general exact seed/read-back is unsupported.

versioning.cookie_merge_apply.reason: Public asynchronous cookie mutation has no qualified transaction or compare-and-swap boundary.
